title: Tanzania Classic camping safari
body:
Our Tented Classic Safaris

A classic tented safari offers a timeless escape into nature. Despite changes over the years, the sight of a simple canvas tent under a shady tree or beside a waterhole remains iconic in the safari experience.
Mazingira Camp partners ensure your comfort and a sense of home. Relax in your tent with the breeze through the canvas, or unwind in the communal area with a book and a refreshing drink. Sit back under the flysheet shade and watch the plains and wildlife.
Evenings bring the cherished safari traditions of drinks and stories around the fire, evoking a sense of simpler times. Enjoy communal dining, celebrating the union of old and new friends. As night falls, the soft lamp light creates a serene ambiance, perfect for stargazing and observing the night's quiet activity.

Your home away from home
Your tent is fully equipped for relaxation and reflection: a comfortable bed with soft linens ensures restful sleep after exciting safari days. The innovative bucket shower, heated over the fire, offers a refreshing end to your day. Mornings begin with the melodies of songbirds as you savor freshly brewed coffee or tea outside your tent. In the afternoon, reflect on your day’s adventures at your writing desk, capturing the memories of your journey.
Mobile camps
Mazingira Camp partners' mobile camps are ingeniously designed to move with the seasons, ensuring guests can experience unique and secluded locations—whether nestled in woodland greenery, under the shadow of a kopje, or along a riverbank. Always closely following the annual wildebeest migration, these camps are set up and taken down leaving only joyful memories behind.
The camps' discreet structures harmonize with the environment, often attracting wildlife right through the campsite. Elephants might choose a spot among the tents for a nap, while leopards could stealthily pass by as you enjoy dinner by the campfire. Staying at these camps offers a profound connection to nature and a deeper appreciation of the wild.
